title: AZ-900 · Describe Azure storage services · Identify Azure data migration options

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure storage services
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Identify Azure data migration options
questions.question: Which statement best describes Azure Migrate?

options.text: Using a Data Box device to transfer large datasets out of Azure
A hub for assessing and migrating on-premises infrastructure, servers, databases, and applications to Azure
A premium account type dedicated to page blobs
A resource that provides a unique namespace for Azure Storage data and exposes storage services through endpoints

questions.explanation: Azure Migrate is a hub for assessing and migrating on-premises infrastructure, servers, databases, and applications to Azure.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure storage services

Replication of data three times within a single datacenter in the primary region

questions.explanation: Discovery and assessment is an Azure Migrate capability for inventorying workloads and evaluating migration readiness.

questions.question: Which of the following is the best definition of Azure Data Box?

options.text: Storage Explorer running on Windows, macOS, and Linux
A command-line utility for uploading, downloading, copying, and one-way synchronizing blobs and files
A physical device-based service for transferring very large data sets when network transfer is impractical
Massively scalable object storage for unstructured text and binary data

questions.explanation: Azure Data Box is a physical device-based service for transferring very large data sets when network transfer is impractical.

questions.question: What is the primary meaning of Online migration in Azure fundamentals?

options.text: A Blob Storage tier optimized for data accessed frequently
Moving workloads and data through network-connected migration tooling such as Azure Migrate
Azure Storage keeping three copies of data in the primary region
AzCopy is used behind the scenes for many Storage Explorer file and blob operations

questions.explanation: Online migration is moving workloads and data through network-connected migration tooling such as Azure Migrate.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure storage services
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Identify Azure data migration options
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Azure Migrate: a physical device-based service for transferring very large data sets when network transfer is impractical.
Discovery and assessment: copying local data to the device and returning it so Microsoft can upload the data into Azure.
Discovery and assessment: an Azure Migrate capability for inventorying workloads and evaluating migration readiness.
Server Migration: the recommended standard account type for most blob, file, queue, and table storage scenarios.
Azure Migrate: a hub for assessing and migrating on-premises infrastructure, servers, databases, and applications to Azure.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Azure Migrate — a hub for assessing and migrating on-premises infrastructure, servers, databases, and applications to Azure; and Discovery and assessment — an Azure Migrate capability for inventorying workloads and evaluating migration readiness.

questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Identify Azure data migration options
questions.question: Which TWO statements accurately reflect the concepts covered in this unit?

options.text: Server Migration: shipping data on a secure physical device such as Azure Data Box.
Server Migration: an Azure Migrate capability for moving server workloads to Azure.
Azure Data Box: a premium account type for block and append blobs requiring high transaction rates or low latency.
Azure Data Box: a physical device-based service for transferring very large data sets when network transfer is impractical.
Azure Data Box: a resource that provides a unique namespace for Azure Storage data and exposes storage services through endpoints.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Server Migration — an Azure Migrate capability for moving server workloads to Azure; and Azure Data Box — a physical device-based service for transferring very large data sets when network transfer is impractical.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure storage services
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Identify Azure data migration options
questions.question: Select TWO correct statements about the material in this Microsoft Learn unit.

options.text: Offline bulk migration: a premium account type for block and append blobs requiring high transaction rates or low latency.
Offline bulk migration: shipping data on a secure physical device such as Azure Data Box.
Online migration: moving workloads and data through network-connected migration tooling such as Azure Migrate.
Online migration: using a Data Box device to transfer large datasets out of Azure.
Online migration: a premium account type for Azure Files that supports SMB and NFS shares.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Online migration — moving workloads and data through network-connected migration tooling such as Azure Migrate; and Offline bulk migration — shipping data on a secure physical device such as Azure Data Box.
